title: October at Vesence
summary: A few moments from a month in four cities: Stockholm, Copenhagen, San Francisco and New York.

## October at Vesence


Stockholm · Copenhagen · San Francisco · New York


A few moments from a month in four cities.


We met law firms, funds and founders, took the stage at Nordic Legal Tech Day and spent our evenings with the people we work with. Between it all, the team stayed heads down on the agent-native computer and shipped a lot.
